changes.to: No maker page for L3 (checked 2026-11-17): Nori now sells the same $1,688 robot as the A3. L3 figures (20 DoF, 1 kg per arm, sub-$2,000) appear only in the founder's 2026-07-28 post announcing pre-orders, and L2 buyers were offered free upgrades to it, so L3 is treated as the earlier name of A3 rather than a separately documented model.
Pre-release name of Nori's sub-$2,000 home robot, announced in July 2026 and now sold as the A3.
